correctness.rationale: The graph has 16 vertices and strongly regular parameters (16,5,0,2). Complete 392-face enumeration and 191-pair acyclic discrete-Morse matching prove only rational H3 of rank 9. The signed reduced simplicial Lefschetz sum and a separately implemented orbit-conflict independent-polynomial recursion agree with the representation formula for every one of the 1920 automorphisms. A 5! point-stabilizer bound proves the exhibited E semidirect S5 is full. Semisimplicity of rational finite-group representations identifies the sum of signed standard and signed coordinate modules. Two independent computations of trace and mod-two chain ranks verify boundary cases; see verify.py and verification_output.txt.

value.rationale: A complete rational module for the full 1920-element natural symmetry group of a canonical strongly regular graph is a motivated invariant. It distinguishes 4 translation-fixed and 5 nontrivial weight character dimensions, all class traces and no full-group invariant classes. These structural features cannot be recovered from the previously known wedge^9 S3 alone. It is a natural complete equivariant refinement rather than an arbitrary chosen small parameter.
